item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera feeds chapati and cooked dal to her pet goat at her home in Jaipur. Her teacher asks the class: from where does the goat get the energy that originally came from the Sun? Which statement is correct?

options.A: The goat gets the Sun's energy only by standing in sunlight, not from its food.
options.B: The goat gets the Sun's energy indirectly, because plants use sunlight to make food and the goat eats food made from plants.
options.C: The goat gets energy only from the food, so the Sun has no role in giving energy to the goat.
options.D: When the goat eats the chapati and dal, energy passes from the goat back into the plants.
